task_name: 20260330_1223_AGENT - Scheduling Contract and Flow Extraction FIX 01
task_file: 20260330_1223_AGENT - Scheduling Contract and Flow Extraction FIX 01.md

manual_verification.general_comment: Scheduling FIX 01 is ready to close. A separate follow-up task was recorded for the long-running regression where the system can sometimes enter booking/contact collection prematurely on the first typed-date submission.

categories.name: Category 1 - Typed Date And Widget Availability

tests.name: Test 1.1 - Specific date resolves to the requested day
tests.purpose: Retest the parent-task failures where typed dates collapsed to the wrong day or to a default next-days window.

rows.action: Ask for availability on a concrete future date with known availability such as `09.04.2026`.
rows.comment: The first submission with 09.04.2026 entered name/phone/email collection prematurely. The second and third attempts behaved as expected. This known long-running regression was recorded in a separate standalone bug task so FIX 01 can still close.

rows.action: Confirm the reply references the interpreted requested date truthfully.
Confirm actionable availability is rendered as a clickable slot widget instead of a plain text list.

tests.name: Test 1.2 - Specific date without availability stays helpful
tests.purpose: Retest the no-availability path for typed-date scheduling without leaking into booking.

rows.action: Ask for availability on a concrete date known to have no slots.
After the no-availability reply, ask a follow-up such as `koga ima sloboden termin`.
Confirm Macedonian no-availability wording is displayed in the tenant-native script rather than Latin transliteration.
rows.what_is_tested: Language/script integrity for scheduling fallback text.

categories.name: Category 2 - Broad, Relative, And Language-Aware Scheduling

tests.name: Test 2.1 - Broad range such as next week narrows truthfully
tests.purpose: Retest broad-range scheduling so it no longer falls back poorly or misstates the request window.

rows.action: Ask for availability using a broad-range phrase such as `slednata nedela` or `next week`.
Confirm the system either states truthful in-range availability or truthful in-range absence, then asks for focused narrowing if appropriate.

tests.name: Test 2.2 - Relative day and time window behave as requested
tests.purpose: Retest combined relative-date and time-window concepts.

rows.action: Ask for something like `termin utre popladne`.
Confirm the returned results are filtered or shaped according to the requested day-plus-time-window and are presented through the clickable widget contract when actionable slots exist.

tests.name: Test 2.3 - Macedonian weekday and period concepts stay contract-consistent
tests.purpose: Retest Macedonian scheduling concepts that previously collapsed to the next day and plain text slot lists.

rows.action: Use Macedonian scheduling concepts such as `sloboden termin vo sreda` and a broad period request such as `slednata nedela`.

categories.name: Category 3 - Slot Handoff And Booking Escape

tests.name: Test 3.1 - Selected slot handoff remains accurate
tests.purpose: Retest the user-visible slot-selection transition for time accuracy and encoding integrity.

rows.action: Reach a clickable slot widget, click a slot, and inspect the immediate follow-up reply before entering the contact fields.
Confirm the selected-slot and surrounding UI text are displayed without mojibake or broken encoding artifacts in both Macedonian and English tenant checks where relevant.
rows.comment: Carries the actionable remark from original passed row 35.

tests.name: Test 3.2 - User can change the chosen slot path
tests.purpose: Retest the missing escape path after slot selection without breaking direct booking handoff.

rows.action: After selecting a slot and entering booking state, try the supported change-slot or back-out path.
